# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.

POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

def proximity_of(mean_latency_ms: float) -> float:
    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 30.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    # Queueing pressure grows faster than linearly with utilisation, so the
    # squared margin is the honest signal: it pushes load away from warm nodes
    # where bursts turn into timeouts while still allowing genuine slack.
    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    headroom_sq = headroom * headroom

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    max_lat = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                lat = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + rate * lat
                weight = weight + rate
                if lat > max_lat:
                    max_lat = lat

    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_lat = weighted / weight
        proximity = proximity_of(mean_lat)
    if max_lat > 0.0:
        tail_penalty = 0.15 * min(max_lat / 100.0, 1.0)
        proximity = proximity - tail_penalty
    if proximity < 0.0:
        proximity = 0.0

    idle = node.power_idle_w
    maxp = node.power_max_w
    estimated_power = idle + (maxp - idle) * peak
    power_score = 1.0 - min(estimated_power / 120.0, 1.0)

    return headroom_sq * 0.55 + proximity * 0.35 + power_score * 0.10

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        dest_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
        both_placed = source_pod.current_node >= 0 and dest_pod.current_node >= 0
        if both_placed and source_pod.current_node != dest_pod.current_node:
            source_node = state.nodes[source_pod.current_node]
            dest_node = state.nodes[dest_pod.current_node]

            cpu_cap_d = float(max(dest_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
            mem_cap_d = float(max(dest_node.mem_capacity, 1))
            cpu_after_d = float(dest_node.cpu_allocated + source_pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap_d
            mem_after_d = float(dest_node.mem_allocated + source_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap_d
            peak_d = max(cpu_after_d, mem_after_d)

            cpu_cap_s = float(max(source_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
            mem_cap_s = float(max(source_node.mem_capacity, 1))
            cpu_after_s = float(source_node.cpu_allocated + dest_pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap_s
            mem_after_s = float(source_node.mem_allocated + dest_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap_s
            peak_s = max(cpu_after_s, mem_after_s)

            source_movable = not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb
            dest_movable = not dest_pod.stateful and not dest_pod.has_pdb

            # Pull one pod toward the other only when the target keeps real
            # burst margin.  Prefer the direction that leaves more headroom.
            if source_movable and not dest_node.suspended and peak_d < 0.55 and peak_d <= peak_s:
                out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
            elif dest_movable and not source_node.suspended and peak_s < 0.55:
                out.append(move_pod(dest_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
    return out

def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def find_pod_index(pod: Pod, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> int:
    for i in range(len(ctx.pods)):
        p = ctx.pods[i]
        same = p.service == pod.service and p.app == pod.app
        same = same and p.cpu_request == pod.cpu_request
        same = same and p.mem_request == pod.mem_request
        same = same and p.stateful == pod.stateful
        same = same and p.image_mb == pod.image_mb
        if same:
            return i
    return -1

def find_node_index(node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> int:
    for i in range(len(ctx.nodes)):
        n = ctx.nodes[i]
        same = n.tier == node.tier and n.cpu_capacity == node.cpu_capacity
        same = same and n.mem_capacity == node.mem_capacity
        same = same and n.power_idle_w == node.power_idle_w
        same = same and n.power_max_w == node.power_max_w
        if same:
            return i
    return -1

        return -1000000.0

    mem = resource_score(mem_after, node.mem_capacity)
    head = (cpu + mem) // 2
    if head == 0:
        return -1000000.0

    cpu_util = 0.0
    if node.cpu_capacity > 0:
        cpu_util = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)

    mem_util = 0.0
    if node.mem_capacity > 0:
        mem_util = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)

    pressure = cpu_util + mem_util

    lat_sum = 0.0
    n = 0
    for lat in node.latency_to_ms:
        lat_sum += lat
        n += 1

    lat_avg = 0.0
    if n > 0:
        lat_avg = lat_sum / float(n)

    tier_bonus = 0.0
    if node.tier == 0:
        tier_bonus = 80.0
    elif node.tier == 1:
        tier_bonus = 30.0

    pod_idx = find_pod_index(pod, ctx)
    node_idx = find_node_index(node, ctx)
    peer_lat_sum = 0.0
    peer_n = 0
    if pod_idx >= 0 and node_idx >= 0:

            s = ctx.graph.src[e]
            d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
            touching = (s == pod_idx) or (d == pod_idx)
            if touching and s != d:

                if d == pod_idx:
                    peer = s
                peer_node = ctx.pods[peer].current_node

                    peer_n += 1

    suspended_penalty = 0.0
    if node.suspended:
        suspended_penalty = 100000.0

    base = float(head) * 100.0 + tier_bonus
    base = base - lat_avg * 4.0
    base = base - peer_lat_avg * 12.0
    base = base - pressure * 400.0
    base = base - power_est * 8.0
    base = base - suspended_penalty
    return base

                dest_movable = not dest_pod.stateful and not dest_pod.has_pdb

                if source_movable and not dest_node.suspended and peak_d < 0.55 and peak_d <= peak_s:
                    out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_pod.current_node))
                    moved = moved + 1
                elif dest_movable and not source_node.suspended and peak_s < 0.55:
                    out.append(move_pod(dest_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                    moved = moved + 1

    return out

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def proximity_of(mean_latency_ms: float) -> float:
    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 30.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    # Queueing pressure grows faster than linearly with utilisation, so the
    # squared margin is the honest signal: it pushes load away from warm nodes
    # where bursts turn into timeouts while still allowing genuine slack.
    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    headroom_sq = headroom * headroom

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    max_lat = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                lat = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + rate * lat
                weight = weight + rate
                if lat > max_lat:
                    max_lat = lat

    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_lat = weighted / weight
        proximity = proximity_of(mean_lat)
    if max_lat > 0.0:
        tail_penalty = 0.15 * min(max_lat / 100.0, 1.0)
        proximity = proximity - tail_penalty
    if proximity < 0.0:
        proximity = 0.0

    idle = node.power_idle_w
    maxp = node.power_max_w
    estimated_power = idle + (maxp - idle) * peak
    power_score = 1.0 - min(estimated_power / 120.0, 1.0)

    return headroom_sq * 0.55 + proximity * 0.35 + power_score * 0.10

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        dest_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
        both_placed = source_pod.current_node >= 0 and dest_pod.current_node >= 0
        if both_placed and source_pod.current_node != dest_pod.current_node:
            source_node = state.nodes[source_pod.current_node]
            dest_node = state.nodes[dest_pod.current_node]

            cpu_cap_d = float(max(dest_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
            mem_cap_d = float(max(dest_node.mem_capacity, 1))
            cpu_after_d = float(dest_node.cpu_allocated + source_pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap_d
            mem_after_d = float(dest_node.mem_allocated + source_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap_d
            peak_d = max(cpu_after_d, mem_after_d)

            cpu_cap_s = float(max(source_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
            mem_cap_s = float(max(source_node.mem_capacity, 1))
            cpu_after_s = float(source_node.cpu_allocated + dest_pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap_s
            mem_after_s = float(source_node.mem_allocated + dest_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap_s
            peak_s = max(cpu_after_s, mem_after_s)

            source_movable = not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb
            dest_movable = not dest_pod.stateful and not dest_pod.has_pdb

            # Pull one pod toward the other only when the target keeps real
            # burst margin.  Prefer the direction that leaves more headroom.
            if source_movable and not dest_node.suspended and peak_d < 0.55 and peak_d <= peak_s:
                out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
            elif dest_movable and not source_node.suspended and peak_s < 0.55:
                out.append(move_pod(dest_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
